The Ops-Core FAST SF Helmet Cover is an effective way to protect and change the visual footprint of the Ops-Core SF line of helmets. The Ops-Core helmet cover is an affordable way to have multiple visual footprints for the same helmet. These helmet covers are compatible with Ops-Core FAST SF Ballistic, FAST MT Ballistic, and FAST SF Carbon Composite helmets.

The Ops-Core SF Helmet Cover is constructed of lightweight and rugged material which feature mesh overlapping vent holes for Carbon Composite helmets to retain air flow. The helmet cover also features paracord attachment points for cable management.

name: Licentia Arms Co. Improved Counterweight Kit

attributes.Color: Black, Black Multicam, Coyote, Ranger Green, Wolf Grey

description:
System: LAC Improved Counterweight Kit

Model: LAC-ICWK Series

Description:

The Licentia Arms Improved Counterweight Kit is a dual role counterweight system that functions as a night vision counterweight and a secure PVS-31 battery pack holder. Constructed from laser cut laminate Cordura the LAC Improved Counterweight Kit is low profile, has positive retention, offers cable management, and has loop velcro for patches.

Adding a counterweight to the back of a night vision helmet helps balance out weight distribution and improves comfort for the user. However, we believe that if weight is added to a helmet it should serve a purpose. Other counterweight kits on the market either are small and provide only lead weights with no functionality or they are large, bulky, and outdated. The LAC Improved Counterweight Kit allows users to use a loaded 10rd PMAG as their counterweight. This not only is the perfect weight to balance out a night vision helmet but also offers additional ammunition storage.

In addition to the ability to run a 10rd PMAG, users who use a PVS-31 battery pack can secure them to their helmet without fear of loosing an expensive battery pack. This not only secures the battery pack, but also protects it while providing cable management solutions. By securing the battery pack cable the user eliminates the need to rig up sub par ways to eliminate snag hazards.

The LAC Improved Counterweight Kit is physically retained on the helmet by both hook velcro and anchors that attach to the rear rail bolts on any helmet. By using high strength shot cord for retention the counterweight kit is universal to all helmets and has two forms of retention. Surrounding the main counterweight compartment there are 6 elastic loops (two on top / bottom & one on each side) to secure chemlights and cables.

Includes :

• Counterweight pouch

• Retention tabs & shot cord

**10rd PMAG / PVS-31 battery pack SOLD SEPARATELY**

System: BNVD-1531

Configuration: BNVD-1531 kit, 2376 min. FOM BNVD-1531 kit, 2376 min. FOM

Description: The L3Harris BNVD-1531 is the result of the L3Harris focus on continuous product improvements in the areas of size, weight, performance and power consumption. The BNVD-1531 offers a lightweight, ergonomic design similar to the AN/PVS-31 but with significant weight reduction over the AN/PVS-15. It also incorporates features such as adjustable diopters, manual gain adjustment, individually rotating monoculars and an integrated infrared illuminator. The L3 BNVD-1531 can be operated as a helmet-mounted or handheld system.

The two main differences between the BNVD-1531 and the PVS-31a is the integrated IR illuminator and adjustable diopters. The BNVD-1531 uses standard milspec PVS-14 optics which gives the user focusable diopters, but also, allows for a more cost effective solution.

name: Licentia Arms Co. RNVG-VG

attributes.Image Intensifier Tubes: L3 Unfilmed White Phosphor 24UA, L3 Unfilmed White Phosphor - High FOM

description:
System: LAC-RNVG-VG(rugedized night vision goggles- variable gain)

Model: LAC-RNVG-VG-FDE-HF

Configuration: L3 24UA, Standard Glass

Description:

The RNVG-VG (Ruggedized Night Vision Goggle – Variable Gain) is a fixed bridge binocular night vision goggle which features an onboard illuminator and manual gain. The RNVG-VG offers superior ruggedness and durability from an Aircraft Grade Aluminum housing. Using an aluminum housing provides extra impact resistance and protects important contact points on the goggle.

The optical pods on the RNVG-VG move along the bridge by turning inter-pupillary distance adjustment screws on each side of the bridge. This allows the user to perfectly position the pods over their eyes for the best image. One benefit to this adjustment style is once the IPD adjustment is set it will not move on the bridge. This allows for a fast deployment of the goggles when flipped up on a Wilcox G24 mount.

In addition to superior durability, the Ruggedized Night Vision Goggle – Variable Gain provides the user manual gain control. Manual gain give the user the ability to manually adjust the output brightness of their tubes by rotating a dial on the goggle. The ability to turn down system brightness decreases eye fatigue and helps the user retain more of their natural night vision.
